The '''capture of the ''Gafra''''' was an operation committed by the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebel Alliance]] during [[Operation Strike Fear]] to the [[BFF-1 bulk freighter/Legends|bulk freighter]] ''[[Gafra]]''.
